tree.heading: In general
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated for each fiscal year such sums as are necessary to carry out this chapter.

tree.heading: Administrative expenses
tree.text: Funds appropriated under subsection (a) may not be used for the payment of the expenses or expenditures of the PromoFlor Council in administering a provision of an order.
